articles.summary: The Jharkhand High Court has set aside the government's cancellation of the JSSC CGL examination. This ruling comes after candidates protested against the decision and alleged irregularities.

articles.title: North Dakota ranchers take $383,375 legal fee fight against pipeline firm to US Supreme Court
articles.summary: The US Supreme Court will hear a dispute involving North Dakota ranchers and WBI Energy Transmission over $383,375.76 in legal fees. The justices will decide whether state or federal law governs compensation when private natural gas companies acquire land through eminent domain..

articles.title: Shaquille O’Neal-backed youth centre attracts 400+ children after $1.1 million makeover
articles.summary: Shaquille O’Neal’s foundation has successfully transformed a dilapidated middle school in Henry County into a vibrant Boys and Girls Club. With a renovation budget of $1.1 million, the facility now features improved educational and recreational spaces.

articles.title: Judge Halts Arch Construction: US court blocks Trump monument for 14 days; veterans’ suits proceed
articles.summary: A federal judge has placed a temporary hold on the construction of a proposed triumphal arch meant to celebrate American independence. Approved by the National Capital Planning Commission, the monument faced opposition from Vietnam War veterans and local entities, who argued it lacked necessary permissions.

articles.title: Three Oklahoma students found their teacher unconscious on concrete after a fall; what they did next earned them a public honour
articles.summary: Three Oklahoma high school students have received public recognition for helping their teacher, Tanya Brawn, after she lost consciousness following a fall outside school on October 8. The students immediately called 911, stayed with her and alerted adults, ensuring she received medical attention.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 1: Film fails to beat Dhurandhar's opening day
